author: Andi Muca
text:
We had a wonderful food tasting experience in Crete with Way to Crete. The tour focused on two of the island’s most important local products: honey and olive oil. We tasted three different varieties of Cretan honey — carob, pine and thyme honey — and it was fascinating to discover how different their aromas and flavours were.

We also had the opportunity to taste Koroneiki olive oil through a food pairing experience, trying it with different local foods and learning how to appreciate its flavour, aroma and characteristics. Ernesto was our guide and made the experience very interesting, relaxed and enjoyable. He shared a lot of knowledge about Cretan traditions, olive oil production and local gastronomy.

A fantastic experience for anyone who wants to discover the authentic flavours of Crete beyond the usual tourist attractions.

author: D Edg
text: Ernest is a nice, respectful and lovely driver. We had a great time there in Crete and could easily travel to other places thanks to him. Pick up times were easy to organize. He even brought us water every time. I would definetly recommend him to others!

author: Helga Geißer
text: Die South Crete Highlights Tour mit Way to Crete war ein wunderschöner Tag und definitiv eines der Highlights unseres Kreta-Urlaubs. Wir haben das beeindruckende Kourtaliotiko-Schlucht, das historische Kloster von Preveli und den berühmten Preveli Beach besucht. Die Landschaft im Süden Kretas war unglaublich schön und die gesamte Tour war sehr gut organisiert. Unser Fahrer war freundlich, professionell und hat uns viele interessante Informationen über die Region gegeben. Eine perfekte Möglichkeit, den authentischen Süden Kretas abseits der üblichen Touristenrouten kennenzulernen. Absolute Empfehlung für eine private Tour ab Rethymno!

It was such a relief knowing that our guests were in good hands and that we didn’t have to worry about transportation on our special day. The communication with the team was also excellent and very easy throughout the whole process.

text: We had several transfers with Ernst during our two week stay in Crete and they all were wonderful. He is super friendly, talkative and most importantly drives nice and calm. He brought my mother-in-law an ice coffee which she enjoyed and appreciated. We have used many transfer services over the years and this is one of the best! He seems very passionate about hiking and Crete, so I wouldn’t hesitate to book a guided tour with him in the future. We will definitely book via Ernst next time we visit Crete. See you soon, Ernst!

text:
We had such a lovely time with Way to Crete. The Spring Flower Tour Adventure felt really special and relaxed, not rushed at all. Walking through the plain was just beautiful—so many wild orchids everywhere, and we even got to see the endemic tulips, which was a highlight. The landscape was full of colors and so peaceful.
At the end, we enjoyed a simple picnic with local treats like dakos, cheese, and olives, which was the perfect way to finish the day. Everything felt genuine and well thought out. Highly recommended!

author: miss Dior
text:
A unique Flower Adventure in Crete that we won’t forget! This Spring Flower Adventure was exactly what we were looking for—focused on nature and far from the usual tourist routes.
We visited the beautiful Yous Kampos, a stunning plain full of wild orchids and spring flowers—truly breathtaking. We saw Tulipa doerfleri, Orchis italica, Ophrys heldreichii, Anacamptis boryi, Himantoglossum robertianum, Orchis pauciflora, and many more!
Our guide Ernesto was polite, friendly, and very knowledgeable, making the whole experience even more special.
Highly recommended for flower lovers looking for an authentic side of Crete!
